The existing keeees witness therefore requires four identical CV syllables internally, with nonempty material on both sides. This is a conditional consequence of old source/form certificates, not new native data or a new source-language exclusion.

scientific_interpretation: Canonical role constraints survive, substantially non-uniquely. Their class sets are mathematical coverage results under the fixed22units and group/source-word contract. No phonetic identity, language, text meaning, actual authorial mechanism, frequency fit or historical usefulness has been established.
stop: The registered classification is complete. Publish the conditional result and stop this experiment. No automatic detailed phoneme-table enumeration, language scan, decoder, relaxed inventory, altered segmentation or rare-word deletion. A later genuinely different source-grounded proposal remains possible under its own stated assumptions; this is not a ban on exploratory hypotheses.
